question: An item is sold for ₹6,500 after two successive discounts of 35% and 20%. What is the marked price (in ₹) of the item?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive discounts ⇒ ×0.65 × 0.80 = 0.52

SP = 52% of MP

MP = 6500 ÷ 0.52 = 12500

**∴ Answer = ₹12500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

SP = ₹6500

Discounts = 35% and 20%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = MP × 0.65 × 0.80

⇒ SP = MP × 0.52

⇒ 6500 = 0.52 × MP

⇒ MP = 6500 ÷ 0.52

⇒ MP = 12500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Multiply remaining fractions: (1 − d₁)(1 − d₂)

Reverse Calculation

MP = SP ÷ (remaining factor)

Tip

Convert percentages into decimals for quick solving.
